roundedShrubRule.interpretation: visual composition rule, not an absolute botanical count across the complete site

treeRules: Use registered trees sparingly and only when the camera can plausibly see their canonical position.
A tree must not obscure the house materially or resemble a large park tree.
Do not introduce an additional recurring permanent fruit tree without first registering its site position.
currentSeriesTreeDecision: No new permanent fruit/apple trees were introduced in the human-approved A01-A05 v1 series. They are not canonical in this version; any later addition requires an explicit versioned change and relevant validation/approval.

free redesign of the complete garden
